topic: Ordering a Copy of the Police Report after a Fender Bender

script.title: AT THE RECORDS WINDOW
script.scene_zh: 警局紀錄組 · 申請報告影本
script.story_hook: A small crash still means a big errand.
script.intro_zh: 一場小追撞，還是得跑一趟繁瑣的差事。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the records window scene. Listen for asking about copies and fees.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到紀錄窗口這一站。留意詢問影本與費用的說法。
script.outro: And that's one report sorted, one digit fixed. Listen once more and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一份報告搞定，一個數字也更正了。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's say each line together, out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句開口跟讀。
script.title_quote: the car looks worse than me
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his forties with short salt-and-pepper hair in a crew cut, a navy windbreaker jacket over a white collared shirt, one work glove tucked in his pocket, and a stocky build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her late twenties with straight black hair in a neat low ponytail, a burgundy knit cardigan over a grey blouse, a small gold watch on one wrist, and an average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the window for accident reports?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈwɪndoʊ fɚ ˈæksədənt rɪˈpɔɹts/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問這裡是事故報告的申請窗口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is. Do you have a case number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz du ju hæv ə ˈkeɪs ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。你有案件編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the officer handed me this slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ði ˈɑfəsɚ ˈhændɪd mi ðɪs slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 有的，到場警官留了這張小單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me see... twenty-one forty-seven, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi si ˈtwɛnti wʌn ˈfɔɹti ˈsɛvən raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……二一四七，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the one. It happened Friday evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn ɪt həˈpænd ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這份。車禍發生在週五傍晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me a sec... found it, Oak and Hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪv mi ə ˈsɛk ˈfaʊnd ɪt ˈoʊk ænd ˈhɪl/
dialogue.zh: 等我一下……找到了，橡樹與希爾路口那件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yep, that's where my bumper met his trunk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ðæts wɛr maɪ ˈbʌmpɚ mɛt hɪz tɹʌŋk/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那個路口，我的保險桿撞上他的車尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both cars drivable, nobody hurt, small win.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ kɑɹz ˈdɹaɪvəbl ˈnoʊbədi hɝt smɑl wɪn/
dialogue.zh: 兩台車都能開，沒人受傷，已經算小事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car looks worse than me, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑɹ lʊks wɝs ðæn mi ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，車看起來比我傷得重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happens a lot at that light, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpənz ə lɑt æt ðæt laɪt baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 順帶一提，那個號誌路口常常出事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, can I get a copy for insurance?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kən aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈkɑpi fɚ ɪnˈʃɝəns/
dialogue.zh: 那我想要一份影本，保險公司要用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but I need photo ID first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɚ bʌt aɪ nid ˈfoʊtoʊ aɪˈdi fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過要先核對你的附照片證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my license. Does the name match?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɚz maɪ ˈlaɪsəns dʌz ðə neɪm mætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 駕照在這裡。名字對得上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly... the report says Alan Powers, no middle initial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ðə rɪˈpɔɹt sɛz ˈælən ˈpaʊɚz noʊ ˈmɪdl ɪˈnɪʃəl/
dialogue.zh: 大致對……報告上寫的是 Alan Powers，沒有中間名首字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine, I never use the middle initial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn aɪ ˈnɛvɚ juz ðə ˈmɪdl ɪˈnɪʃəl/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我從不用中間名首字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, you're cleared. Want one copy or two?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ jʊɚ klɪrd wɑnt wʌn ˈkɑpi ɔɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 好，核對完成。你要一份影本還是兩份？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, one for me and one for my agent.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wʌn fɚ mi ænd wʌn fɚ maɪ ˈedʒənt/
dialogue.zh: 兩份，一份我留著，另一份保險經紀人要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Heads up, some parts are blacked out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsmɑɹt ˈhɛdz ˌʌp səm pɑɹts ɑɹ blækt ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。先提醒你，有些欄位會用黑條遮掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blacked out? Like, my home address too?
dialogue.phonetic: /blækt aʊt laɪk maɪ ˈhoʊm əˈdrɛs tu/
dialogue.zh: 遮掉？像我的住家地址也會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yup, privacy rules hide phone numbers and addresses.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʌp ˈpɹvaɪsi ɹulz haɪd foʊn ˈnʌmbɚz ænd ˈædɹɛsəz/
dialogue.zh: 對，隱私規定會遮電話與地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh, mine's blacked out too... uh, I guess that's normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌ maɪnz blækt aʊt tu ʌh aɪ ɡɛs ðæts ˈnɔɹməl/
dialogue.zh: 咦，我的也遮起來了……呃，應該很尋常吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Insurance gets the same version, so no worries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈʃɝəns ɡɛts ðə seɪm ˈvɝʒən soʊ noʊ ˈwɝɪz/
dialogue.zh: 保險公司拿到的也是同一份，所以放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. Does it list who was at fault?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡʊd tə ˈnoʊ dʌz ɪt ˈlɪst hu wəz æt ˈfɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 知道就好。報告會寫是誰的責任嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see... the officer wrote undetermined here.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts si ði ˈɑfəsɚ roʊt ˌʌndɪˈtɝmɪnd hɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……警官在這裡寫了責任未定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Undetermined? Um, that's new for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɪˈtɝmɪnd ʌm ðæts nju fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 責任未定？嗯，我頭一回見到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens when both drivers tell different stories.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz wɛn boʊθ ˈdɹaɪvɚz tɛl ˈdɪfɹənt ˈstɔɹiz/
dialogue.zh: 兩位駕駛說法不一樣時就會這樣標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, he says I moved over too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl hi sɛz aɪ ˈmoʊvd ˈoʊvɚ tu fæst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，他堅稱是我變線太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you saw him move before the bump?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ju sɔ hɪm muv bɪˈfɔɹ ðə bʌmp/
dialogue.zh: 而你認為，是他先動才撞上的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, my dashcam caught the whole thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ ˈdæʃkæm kɔt ðə hoʊl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，行車紀錄器拍到整個過程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, nice! Was the file given to the officer?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs wəz ðə faɪl ˈɡɪvən tə ði ˈɑfəsɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，太好了！警官有沒有收到那段檔案？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, um, I mailed that clip yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ʌm aɪ meɪld ðæt klɪp ˈjɛstɚdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，嗯，那段影片我昨天才寄出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, it's not attached to this report yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪts nɑt əˈtætʃt tə ðɪs rɪˈpɔɹt jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這份報告目前還沒附上影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they add it later, if insurance asks?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðeɪ æd ɪt ˈleɪɾɚ ɪf ɪnˈʃɝəns æsks/
dialogue.zh: 保險公司若要求，他們之後能補進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'd review the file, but the report won't change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪd rɪˈvju ðə faɪl bʌt ðə rɪˈpɔɹt woʊnt tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 他們會檢視檔案，不過報告本身不會改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Now, how do we handle the fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɛɹ ɪˈnʌf naʊ haʊ du wi ˈhændəl ðə fi/
dialogue.zh: 合理。那麼，費用該怎麼處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four dollars a copy, so eight for two.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ˈdɑɹləz ə ˈkɑpi soʊ eɪt fɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 一份四塊，兩份就是八塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheaper than my dentist, that's for sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃipɚ ðæn maɪ ˈdɛntɪst ðæts fɚ ʃʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 比看醫生便宜，這倒是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, card works fine, or exact cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kɑɹd wɝks faɪn ɔɹ ˈɪɡzækt kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，刷卡沒問題，或是準備剛好的現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll tap my card... there, did it work?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈtæp maɪ ˈkɑɹd ðɛɹ dɪd ɪt ˈwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 我靠一下卡……有了，扣款成功了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, all set. Receipt's in the little tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ɔl sɛt rɪˈsɪts ɪn ðə ˈlɪɾəl tɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好了，成功。收據放在小托盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, can you mail his copy to his office?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ kæn ju meɪl hɪz ˈkɑpi tə hɪz ˈɔfəs/
dialogue.zh: 另外，他那份能直接幫我寄到他辦公室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can, for three dollars shipping. Want that?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn fɚ θɹi ˈdɑɹləz ˈʃɪpɪŋ wɑnt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，加收三塊運費。要這個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. He's the picky one about paperwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz hiz ðə ˈpɪki wʌn əˈbaʊt ˈpeɪpɚwɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，他在文件上最講究。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, we love picky, it keeps us careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wi lʌv ˈpɪki ɪt kips ʌs ˈkɛɚfəl/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我們歡迎挑剔的人，那樣最保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how many days till the mailed copy lands?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ ˈmɛni deɪz tɪl ðə meɪld ˈkɑpi lændz/
dialogue.zh: 那寄到的話，大約幾天會送達？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five business days by mail, or pick it up today.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈbɪznəs deɪz baɪ meɪl ɔɹ pɪk ɪt ʌp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 寄送要五個工作日，或今天直接來拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take mine today, and mail his, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk maɪn təˈdeɪ ænd meɪl hɪz pliz/
dialogue.zh: 我今天先領我的，他那份請幫我寄出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Now, one small thing looks off here.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn naʊ wʌn smɔl θɪŋ lʊks ˈɔf hɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好了。不過，有個小地方好像不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off how? Oh no, is it my license number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf haʊ oʊ noʊ ɪz ɪt maɪ ˈlaɪsəns ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡不對？糟了，是我的駕照號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last digit reads seven, should be nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə læst ˈdɪdʒɪt ridz ˈsɛvən ʃʊd bi naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，最後一位寫成七，應該是九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No wonder my agent texted something weird.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwʌndɚ maɪ ˈedʒənt ˈtɛkst ˈsʌmθɪŋ wɪɚd/
dialogue.zh: 難怪我的經紀人早上傳了奇怪的訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll flag it now, they'll print new copies.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl flæɡ ɪt naʊ ðeɪl prɪnt nu ˈkɑpiz/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就標記，他們會重印新的影本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay again for the fixed version?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ əˈɡɛn fɚ ðə fɪkst ˈvɝʒən/
dialogue.zh: 更正的那份，我要再付一次錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, office mistakes are free, policy says so.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ˈɔfəs məˈskeɪts ɑɹ fri ˈpɑləsi sɛz soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們弄錯的都免費重發，規定如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Um, is there anything left to sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl ʌm ɪz ðɛɹ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ lɛft tə saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。嗯，還有東西需要我簽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just this pickup slip. Your copies are ready, sir.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðɪs ˈpɪkʌp slɪp jɔɚ ˈkɑpiz ɑɹ ˈrɛdi sɝ/
dialogue.zh: 只要簽這張取件單。您的影本好了，先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You saved me a real headache. Thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju seɪvd mi ə ɹiəl ˈhɛdˌeɪk θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你幫我省下大麻煩，真的謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Drive easy, that bumper deserves a rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm dɹaɪv ˈizi ðæt ˈbʌmpɚ dɪˈzɝvz ə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。慢慢開，你的保險桿需要休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, will do. Have a calm afternoon at this window.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɪl du hæv ə kɑm ˈæftɚˌnuːn æt ðɪs ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我會的。祝你下午這個窗口清閒一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye now, and hey — watch that left lane.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ naʊ ænd ˈheɪ wɑtʔ ðæt lɛft leɪn/
dialogue.zh: 再見啦，還有——左邊車道可要小心喔。

script.youtube_title: 【車禍後領報告🚗】「老實說，車看起來比我傷得重」💔事故報告影本怎麼申請📄｜核對證件・問遮罩欄位・刷卡付費💳｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Police Report Copy
script.youtube_title_en: "The Car Looks Worse Than Me" — Getting a Police Report Copy for Insurance
script.youtube_description:
「老實說，車看起來比我傷得重」——車禍隔天，你帶著案件編號來到警局紀錄窗口，要用一份事故報告影本交給保險公司。這是一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在警察局的申請櫃台前。

你會聽到：報出案件編號、核對附照片證件的完整開場；發現名字少了中間名時怎麼幽默帶過；隱私遮罩（電話、地址都用黑條蓋掉）該怎麼問、怎麼理解；責任寫成未定、行車紀錄器還沒歸檔時該追問什麼；還有影本費用、刷卡、請櫃檯逕寄到保險經紀人辦公室的實用說法。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人辦日常事務的真實語感：um、well、hmm、yep、fair enough。聽完你就會用：Do you have a case number?、Can I get a copy for insurance?、Some parts are blacked out.、Anytime。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The car looks worse than me" — the day after a small fender bender, you stand at the police records window with one job: get a copy of the accident report for insurance. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at the counter.

You will hear: giving your case number and showing photo ID; laughing off a missing middle initial on the report; asking why phone numbers and addresses come blacked out for privacy; following up on an undetermined fault note and a dashcam clip still in the mail; and paying per copy, tapping your card, or having one copy mailed to your agent.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk Americans actually use at service counters: um, well, hmm, yep, fair enough. By the end you'll own phrases like Do you have a case number?, Can I get a copy for insurance?, and Some parts are blacked out.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
